question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unrest**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **Unrest **refers to a state of dissatisfaction or disturbance among a group of people. (व्याकुलता)

 
 
• **Example**: *Political unrest gripped the capital, leading to protests in the streets.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.

Therefore, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cohesion **refers to the action of sticking together or the ability to work well together. (एकजुटता)
 
• **Stigma **refers to a mark of disgrace or shame. (कलंक)
 
• **Solidarity **refers to unity or mutual support within a group. (एकजुटता)
